newsitem.title: CHINA: Kader mulls stake sale to Chinese firm.
newsitem.headline: Kader mulls stake sale to Chinese firm.

text.p: Kader Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was in talks to sell a stake of more than 20 percent of the company to a mainland Chinese company.
"The company is in preliminary discussions with an independent third party in mainland China...in relation to a possible acquisition of shares by the (Chinese) party," it said in a statement.

The mainland firm will buy the shares, which will represent more than 20 percent of the company's share capital, either from Kader's 56 percent controlling shareholder Ting family or by an issue of new shares by the company, it said.
The company said the Ting family intended to retain control in the company but that no agreement had yet been reached.
Kader shares gained HK$0.02 to HK$1.79 at midday after they hit a morning high of HK$1.84.
